delegation.owner_question: 疾管署資料要不要跟健保、食藥署一樣，官方出新版時自動檢查、全部通過就換上？

checklist: The display text rules are unchanged, so wrapped lines are joined and numbered items stay on their own lines as reviewed.
應保存種類（應保存時間） keeps its official name and results carry not_pre_submission_storage=true.
The packaged alias table only decides which wording is searched; answers keep the manual's own disease names, and its version is part of the build fingerprint (OD-16).
檢驗期限 and 檢驗期間 are kept apart under their official names and neither is presented as the other.
實驗室生物安全等級(BSL) is shown as printed and never turned into an instruction about where a laboratory may test.
A receiving unit's contact details are shown as the manual prints them; chapter 2 and chapter 7 rows are not merged into one answer.
The revision table's change list is used only to say which printed page changed and why; it is never presented as the manual's current content.
A clause is stored and shown as printed, with its own number; steps are never reordered, merged or summarised.
A figure caption stays a caption and is never presented as a step.
Chapters 3 to 6 answer how to collect, pack and transport a specimen; they are not merged with the chapter 2 rows or presented as a disease-specific rule.
CDC-R1-CONTENT.purpose: Each served row keeps the presentation reviewed under cdc-manual-r1-ai-review/1.

checklist: pypdfium2 and PDFium equal the packaged qualifier spec.
The reading rules (layout rules version, curated columns, normalization, qualifier spec) equal those of the served build.
Rows and distinct diseases change by at most 10%; the blank rate of any column except 應保存種類（應保存時間） rises by at most 2 percentage points.
Every golden case picked from the new manual passes.
Before the pointer switches, every stored cell equals the Word table tag text of the same PDF.
Chapter 7 columns follow the header text as printed: 傳染病名稱, 採檢單位, 採檢項目, 檢驗方法, 檢驗期限, 收件單位, 實驗室生物安全等級(BSL) and 備註; section 7.7 prints 檢驗期間 instead of 檢驗期限 and has no BSL column.
Every chapter 7 column ends a row, so two arrangements that differ only by their 檢驗期限 stay separate rows.
Section 7.9 is read as its own table of 單位名稱, 電話, 傳真 and 地址.
Chapter 2 and chapter 7 rows are read from their own pages only; a header that matches no chapter blocks the build.
The revision table's change list is read from its own PDF and kept as build evidence; its 修正規定 and 現行規定 columns are not copied into the database.

Chapters 3 to 6 are read as numbered clauses and figure captions, one row each, with the number as printed; a clause number must be followed by a dot or a space, a bare chapter number must print its dot, table-of-contents lines with dot leaders start nothing and a numbered line inside a table cell is table content.
The two small tables inside these chapters keep their cells apart with 「｜」 and each row on its own line.
Before the pointer switches, the stored chapters 3 to 6 are put back together and compared with those pages character by character: nothing dropped, duplicated or moved.
CDC-R1-LAYOUT.purpose: Every chapter 2 row is rebuilt from the PDF layout with each cell in its own column.

checklist: The attachments are chosen by label on the official manual page and carry the same version.
Both files are PDFs whose sizes and SHA-256 match fetch.json.
Every chapter 2 table page header prints the attachment version as 版次.
CDC-R1-SOURCE.purpose: Both raw artifacts are the specimen manual and its revision table attached to the official CDC page.

checklist: Only an installed distribution may publish.
When any check fails, the served manual keeps answering, marked as having a newer candidate, and the owner is emailed once.
Download bundles contain only the raw revision and the curated build with its audit folder (docs/adr/0004-cdc-snapshot-release-bundle.md).
PUB-R1-OWNER.purpose: The build may be served by the local MCP runtime and redistributed as a GitHub Release download bundle.

golden_cases.comparison: Compare each expected raw and display value, the locator and the row hash with the rows read from the new manual PDF.
